fact: ECOWAS reports that in July 2024 Burkina Faso, with Côte d'Ivoire, Togo, Benin, Ghana, Mali and Niger, was connected to SIGMAT for electronic exchange of transit data between customs administrations.
title: For Better Knowledge And Understanding Of The Interconnected System For The Management Of Goods In Transit (SIGMAT)
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
